title: Algerian Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful wrap filled with grilled chicken, tangy liver pâté, and crunchy vegetables. This Algerian-inspired dish is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Algerian light seasoning
ingredients.notes: A blend of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Season the chicken breast with Algerian light seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Brush the chicken liver with quaint olive oil and grill for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the light wrap in the microwave or on the grill.
Slice the grilled chicken and liver into thin strips.
Assemble the wrap by placing the chicken and liver strips on the wrap, followed by lettuce and tomato.
